## Courses

I have served as a teaching assistant in the Department of Civil Engineering at Aalto University, supporting courses at both bachelor's and master's levels.

::: {.course-item}
[2025 · Spring]{.eyebrow}

### Sustainability and Circular Economy in Civil Engineering

**Master's course · Aalto University**  
Teaching assistant. Course teacher: Weiwei Lin.
:::

::: {.course-item}
[2022–2025 · Autumn]{.eyebrow}

### Maintenance and Repair of Structures

**Master's course · Aalto University**  
Teaching assistant. Course teacher: Weiwei Lin.

The course covers maintenance, repair, strengthening, corrosion protection, and residual service-life evaluation. Students develop a report on sustainable repair measures for an existing project.

Archived course pages: [2023](https://mycourses.aalto.fi/course/view.php?id=39209) · [2022](https://mycourses.aalto.fi/course/view.php?id=35459).
:::
